edit.description: `host_units` (line 350) and `discover_kind_units` (line 448) each hand-join `disc.harness()` to `governs.root` — the first normalizing the result, the second leaving `scan_locus` to. New `pub(crate) fn locus_root(&self, governs: &Governs) -> PathBuf` on `Discovery` is the one join-and-normalize both read; `pub(crate)` because the only consumers are in-crate (this module, `compose`) and the pin is in-module. `scan_locus` keeps its own normalize — it also takes a host unit directory, so it cannot presume a pre-normalized root. The unit pin lands in this module's `mod tests`.

line 1036's `crate::path::normalize_path(&disc.harness().join(&governs.root))` is the third copy — the `governs` read branch, feeding `drift::fold_base(&root, &governs.glob)`. It reads `disc.locus_root(governs)` instead. The `.`-rooted fold-base pin already in this module's `mod tests` (around line 2311) is the behavior this copy had to get right alone and must stay green.

summary: The on-disk root a `governs` locus names is hand-joined and re-normalized at three sites; give the join one home on `Discovery`.

tests.asserts: `Discovery::locus_root` returns the normalized on-disk root for a `.claude/skills`-rooted `governs` and for a `.`-rooted one — the two edges each hand-pairing had to get right alone, the harness join and the `.` drop
the existing `.`-rooted fold-base pin still holds with the root read off the one producer rather than joined in place

acceptance: `cargo test` green, with `rg 'harness\(\)\.join\(&governs\.root\)' src/` resolving to the single site inside `Discovery::locus_root`.
notes: Census by behavior: that join expression appears at src/import.rs:350, src/import.rs:448 and src/compose.rs:1036, and nowhere else. `install.rs`'s `locus_member_sites` (1298) joins a locus root too, but it is the guard's own walkdir walk whose doc declares at the site why `import`'s index is the wrong reuse — out of scope. An added method reaches none of `Discovery::new`'s other callers (gate, read, install, json_manifest, tests/it). scoped at 72e833f2
